STASI was a QuakeWorld clan founded by the leaders [[Marx]] and [[jENs]] of the former RealQuake clan [[Chaos from Kreml]] in late 1997. One year later STASI was put to rest by [[Nikita]] and Marx when both players left the clan to join  [[Beasts of Deletion]]. In 1999 the LPB-clan [[Spartacus]] was founded by [[Marx]] ([[Ubermann]]), [[Nikita]], [[RinceWind]] ([[Angua]]) and [[Daver]] and STASI got dusted off as the HPW-division of [[Spartacus]]. Among the players in the refounded STASI was the danish player [[Warrior]] and swedish players [[Xorgal]] and Kask ([[Trinidy]]).

During the two years the clan was active STASI played over 60 official games and had over 30 listed players.
